summary: Joint Stock Co Kaspi.kz furnished a Form 6-K reporting results of its September 9, 2026 extraordinary general meeting, at which shareholders approved a 2Q 2026 dividend of KZT 1,000 per common share, payable in cash by wire transfer. The record date is September 8, 2026, with payment commencing September 9, 2026; no board recommendation or advisor is disclosed. This is a routine capital-return action for a foreign private issuer, the US-equivalent special situation being a declared dividend, not a tender or buyback. What to watch: future payout cadence and any buyback authorization.
